process_subject(subject: str, session: str | None = None)[source]

Process a single subject.

This is the main processing method that subclasses must implement. It should contain the complete processing pipeline for one subject.

Parameters:

  • subject – Subject ID (e.g., ‘sub-01’)

  • session – Optional session ID (e.g., ‘ses-01’)

Raises:

ProcessingError – If processing fails

Preprocessing workflow for DWI: - Takes a context dict (DWI files, topup groups, etc.) - Applies configurable steps in sequence.

build_pipeline(context: dict)[source]
run(output_dir: Path, context: dict, reporter=None) → dict[source]

Execute the workflow on a list of DWI files.

Anatomical Processing Pipeline (anat_proc).

  1. Resample/resize

  2. Reorient to standard

  3. Denoise

  4. Gibbs correction

  5. Bias correction

  6. Coregistration (T1w <-> T2w)

  7. Brain Mask

  8. FreeSurfer Recon-all (optional)

  9. Nonlinear Registration (to template)
